title: Can Large Language Model Agents Simulate Human Trust Behavior?

bias_targets.methodology: Specifying the gender of the trustee in the Trust Game prompt and comparing the monetary amount sent by the LLM trustor agent to male versus female players.

Specifying the race of the trustee in the Trust Game prompt (e.g., African American, Asian American, White American, Latino American, American Indian) and measuring the change in the average amount sent by the LLM trustor agent.
Explicitly specifying the identity of the trustee as either an LLM agent or a human in the Trust Game prompt and evaluating the difference in the monetary amount sent by the trustor agent.
